newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: OFFICIAL RESERVES OF CENTRAL BANK ROSE IN JUNE.
newsitem.headline: OFFICIAL RESERVES OF CENTRAL BANK ROSE IN JUNE.

text.p: Lithuania's central bank said on Tuesday that its official reserves rose to $939.6 million at the end of June from $883.3 million at the end of May.
The bank said in a statement that its official reserves in June increased by $56.3 million or by 6.4 percent.
It also said that its convertible currency reserves advanced to $859.1 million in June from $812.7 million at the end of May.
Its holdings of SDRs rose by 115.9 percent to $18.4 million at the end of June from $8.5 million the previous month, the bank said.
Gold reserves remained unchanged in June at $62.1 million, the bank added.
